  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:0.5in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">F-</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">53</span></p></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;"/>
  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:0.5in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><ix:continuation id="F_610fde54-2d2d-42d9-b7ec-431b5f20d91f_2"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">tax liability for its UK subsidiary.  Also, none of the GAAP basis of Goodwill recorded in relation to the Vidello, Ltd. acquisition is deductible for tax purposes.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On July 4, 2025, the U.S. government enacted the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), which includes several changes to U.S. federal income tax law, including temporary and permanent extension, of expiring provisions of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017. Significant provisions for corporate taxpayers include permanent </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"><ix:nonFraction id="F_2c364b85-ac9c-475d-99fd-ad5edd12949b" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="bnzi:PercentageOfProvisionsForCorporateTaxpayersIncludePermanentBonusDepreciation" unitRef="U_pure" scale="-2" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">100</ix:nonFraction></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% bonus depreciation for qualified property, immediate expensing of domestic R&amp;D expenditures, and changes to the limitation on business interest expense deductions under Section 163(j). None of these provisions have a material impact on the Company&#8217;s 2025 income tax provision.</span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company has determined that it had </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"><ix:nonFraction id="F_52d8a571-e11b-49f0-89b3-a245522ad25b" contextRef="C_15121e93-77e8-4d91-a64d-330d3e64f823" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" unitRef="U_USD" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction id="F_39c9aa76-adf0-48b8-aaa6-8ad1cee5e2dc" contextRef="C_2af9013e-60ec-4308-851f-146718610d10" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" unitRef="U_USD" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> material uncertain tax benefits for the year ended December 31, 2025, and 2024. The Company recognizes interest accrued related to unrecognized tax benefits and penalties in interest expense and penalties in operating expense. </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"><ix:nonFraction id="F_ce56bb19-ab34-48f6-b263-19f8ede9d6ec" contextRef="C_15121e93-77e8-4d91-a64d-330d3e64f823" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" unitRef="U_USD" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction id="F_494eafd2-d89b-467c-8c7b-8f07fd34bcb0" contextRef="C_2af9013e-60ec-4308-851f-146718610d10" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" unitRef="U_USD" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">No</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> amounts were accrued for the payment of interest and penalties at December 31, 2025, and 2024.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company files tax returns as prescribed by the tax laws of the jurisdictions in which they operate. In the normal course of business, the Company is subject to examination by federal, state, and foreign jurisdictions where applicable based on the statute of limitations that apply in each jurisdiction. As of December 31, 2025, the </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><ix:nonNumeric id="F_c69edc64-a919-4242-a6ed-635f95c3d070" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:OpenTaxYear"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">2018</span></ix:nonNumeric></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and subsequent tax years related to all US jurisdictions remain open.</span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><ix:nonNumeric id="F_a7533d54-2dab-42b8-88bc-be1cf2b67784" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxExaminationDescription"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company has no open tax audits with any taxing authority as of December 31, 2025.</span></ix:nonNumeric></span></p></ix:continuation></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><div><ix:nonNumeric id="F_5ef87e99-878f-4ae0-90f5-f0ce8a01a405" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock" escape="true" continuedAt="F_5ef87e99-878f-4ae0-90f5-f0ce8a01a405_1"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">18. Segment Reporting</span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company has </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"><ix:nonFraction id="F_9c386b55-bdd1-4361-ae04-3482c81e0732" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" unitRef="U_Segment" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction id="F_e8257f9c-148e-4b33-a27c-fb9423da1c16" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:NumberOfOperatingSegments" unitRef="U_Segment" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">three</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> reportable operating segments, Banzai Operating Co, Inc., OpenReel, and Vidello. Segment adjusted EBITDA excludes certain non-cash items or items that management does not consider reflective of ongoing core operations.</span></ix:nonNumeric></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> Currently, the CODM does not review assets in evaluating the results of the operating segments, and therefore, such information is not presented.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><div><ix:nonNumeric id="F_8aaa03bf-3032-4def-a78a-e59a344eb08c" contextRef="C_79291c09-8942-408d-a184-8d1a1f2675e7" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock" escape="true" continuedAt="F_8aaa03bf-3032-4def-a78a-e59a344eb08c_1"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The table below presents information about segments for the </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">year ended December 31, 2025:</span></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p>
